featured_reviews.name: viraj s wadkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dr. Khopkar Skin Clinic & Dermatopathology Services and my experience has been excellent.

Dr. Uday Khopkar is truly one of the best dermatologists in Mumbai. He is extremely polite, professional, and highly knowledgeable. He carefully understands the root cause of the issue and then prescribes the right medicines. Proper skin examination and blood tests are done before starting treatment, which gives confidence in the diagnosis.

The blood test facility is available inside the clinic itself (Metropolis lab services), which is very convenient. They charge separately for it, but it ensures accurate and reliable reports.

Consultation charges are ₹2500 for the first visit and ₹1500 for follow-up within a year. Medicines and test charges are different. But it’s worth the penny.

The receptionist is helpful and polite. She explained everything clearly over the phone and guided me properly during my visit. My appointment call was answered on the first attempt.

The clinic is just 2 minutes walking distance from Dadar East railway station, which makes it very easy to reach. Since it is close to the station, parking is not available.

One important thing — many patients come from faraway areas for treatment. Because of this, your appointment may not always be exactly on time. So please keep patience. Good treatment is more important than waiting time.

Dr. Khopkar’s qualifications and experience speak for themselves:
•	M.D., D.V.D., D.N.B., F.I.D.P. (USA)
•	Ex-Professor & Head, Department of Dermatology, KEM Hospital & Seth GS Medical College, Mumbai
•	Chief Editor, IJDVL (2003–2008)
•	Honorary Dermatologist to the Governor of Maharashtra

I highly recommend this clinic to everyone. Don’t waste money at fancy clinics — here you will get proper diagnosis and the right treatment.
